beliefs: The box reverses the order of characters in the input string [E1]
Reversal preserves case, digits, punctuation, and spaces exactly, only order changes [E1]
Whitespace-only strings map to empty string [E2]
Leading whitespace is stripped from the input before reversal [E2, E3]
Trailing whitespace is also stripped from the input before reversal, so 'a  b  ' -> 'b  a' and ' a  b ' -> 'b  a ' [E4, E5]
Equivalently: strip both ends, then reverse [E4, E5]
notes: E4 and E5 show trailing whitespace is stripped before reversal (not after), so the rule is strip both ends then reverse, not strip-leading/reverse/strip-leading.
